summary: Group 3 (Volunteer Service Hours + Time Tracking, Milestone Certificates, Check-In Assignment) verified end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite test_group3_hours_certs_assign.py — 21/21 pass in ~4s covering: clock-in creates 'active' + second clock-in -> 400; clock-out sets 'pending' with computed hours; clock-out with none active -> 400; clock/manual without linked member profile -> 400 (validated with admin who has no member profile); manual hours ok + <=0/>24 -> 400; /service-hours/me shape (entries, summary{approved,pending,active,earned_milestones}, milestones_available=[20,50,100], member_id) with earned_milestones containing 20 from seeded data; member can DELETE own pending, cannot delete approved (400), non-owner non-staff -> 403; staff list has entries/counts{pending,approved,rejected,active}/totals and non-staff -> 403; PUT /status invalid -> 400, non-staff -> 403, approve -> 200; PUT /{id} edit staff-only (member 403, staff 200 persists); /service-hours/summary rows include mem_memba with approved>=20; /service-hours/export.csv 200 + text/csv + expected header columns; certificate 20.pdf -> 200 with %PDF; 50.pdf -> 400 (below); milestone 33 invalid -> 400; non-owner non-staff -> 403; staff can access any cert -> 200; GET /checkin-assignable staff-only (4+ users, correct shape) + non-staff 403; PUT /events/{id}/checkin-assignees notifies newly-added user (verified +1 notification), does NOT re-notify when same set re-saved, and adds a timeline entry to the member profile of the newly-added user (verified via timeline collection). Regression: prior group1/group2/group3-events-gallery suites still 47 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend: /portal/service-hours renders role-adaptive UI. STAFF sees admin-hours with hours-tab-{pending(0)|approved(2)|rejected(0)|active(0)} counts, hours-month, hours-export, hours-summary (Member PhaseA 22h chip), admin-hours-row-* with reject-hours-{id}/edit-hours-{id}; edit dialog opens with save-hours-edit. MEMBER (ambassador tok_amb_g3test) sees member-hours with 3 summary cards (Approved 22, Pending 0, Milestones 1), Recognition section with cert-20 (earned) and NO cert-50/cert-100 as expected, clock-activity/clock-category/clock-in-btn/add-manual-btn; manual dialog opens with manual-hours/manual-submit-btn; 2 history rows. EventManage Volunteers tab: 'Manage — event' dialog -> tab-volunteers -> volunteers-panel with 4 assignee-* checkboxes (search works) + save-assignees-btn. MemberDetail /portal/members/mem_memba -> tab-hours -> member-hours-tab shows 22h/0h totals with member-cert-20 button visible (member-cert-50 hidden) and mh-reject-{id} for 2 approved entries (mh-approve hidden since all approved).

issues: Layout: on desktop the modal overlays the page but Date field is quite narrow while Hours field is huge — asymmetric column widths make the form feel unbalanced. Cosmetic only.

Delete/'x' button next to approved entries visually implies deletion but backend returns 400 for approved (correctly). Consider hiding the X icon when status=='approved' to avoid mis-clicks (mirrors the ServiceHours page behavior which already hides it for approved).

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: hide the delete 'x' on approved entries inside MemberHoursTab.jsx (line ~40) to match ServiceHours.jsx member-side behavior.
OPTIONAL: balance Date/Hours column widths in ServiceHours.jsx manual dialog (grid uses 2 cols but Date input has type=date with narrow visible width).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DELETE /service-hours/{hid}: staff can delete ANY entry including approved (no 400 guard). Fine for admin override, but there is no audit warning and no 'reverse milestone' — deleting an approved 2h entry that brought total to 20 will NOT revoke the earned milestone (hour_milestones list is add-only in _check_hour_milestones). Consider recomputing milestones on delete/edit-away-from-approved to keep hour_milestones consistent.

server.py _check_hour_milestones only runs on set_hours_status(approved) and edit_hours when status=='approved'. If a status is changed from approved -> rejected via PUT /status, previously earned milestones stay on the member indefinitely even if total drops below threshold. Add a recompute-on-demote path.

server.py clock_in: 'active' rows have hours=0.0 but summary includes active as a separate object (not summed). OK for /me, but the admin totals aggregation in list_service_hours excludes 'active' from totals (only sums approved+pending) — the docstring hint 'active hours do not count' matches, but on the UI admin totals card there is no line for potential active volunteers currently clocked-in, which staff might want to see.
checkin_assignable returns ALL users regardless of account_status. Suspended/inactive users still appear in the assignable list. Consider filtering account_status=='active'.

PUT /events/{id}/checkin-assignees requires get_current_user (not STAFF_ROLES) and allows event owner (ambassador) to set assignees. However, GET /checkin-assignable is STAFF_ROLES only, so a non-staff owner cannot fetch the list to know which user_ids to assign. Either restrict the PUT to staff too, or expose a scoped assignable list to event owners.
server.py now 3674 lines. Split service_hours + certificates into their own module.

MemberHoursTab shows an 'x' icon on every entry regardless of status; clicking it on approved returns 400 from backend (correct) but UX-wise the icon should be hidden or disabled for approved (mirrors ServiceHours member-side pattern).
